item.title: Massive new data centers are being built across the country whet...
item.description: Massive new data centers are being built across the country whether we’re ready for them or not. This is our moment to decide the terms at zoning meetings and utility hearings, in written testimony, and at the ballot box.As hyperscalers come into communities to build these data centers, we should be asking: what tech will it be using, and how is it powered? Who pays for any necessary grid upgrades? What benefits does the surrounding community receive, and are those promises legally binding?I have another video that will go into the details on all of this coming soon, so watch this space for more info!

item.title: Learning how to exercise my rights with the legend herself, @jan...
item.description: Learning how to exercise my rights with the legend herself, @janefonda!If you didn’t already know, Jane Fonda has always been a badass, both on and off screen. She’s a longtime champion of free speech and the right to protest. I met her through the Committee for the First Amendment, which was originally formed during the McCarthy era by Hollywood heavyweights like her father, Henry Fonda. She relaunched it last year. Its mission to protect free speech against government repression and industry complicity has arguably never been more important, and I’m now a proud member of that committee.Thanks, Jane, for always standing up for our rights. And for squatting, lunging, stretching, and crunching for our rights too - haha. We filmed a workout skit today and I broke a sweat for real whereas Jane was as cool as a damn cucumber. Of course she was! @victorshi @thegroundlings @1acommittee
